theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {t : ℝ} (ht_int_pos : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ) (ht_int_neg : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (-t * X ω)) μ) : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|)) μ := by
  let f := fun ω => Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|)
  have h_f_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f :=
    by intro ω; exact Real.exp_nonneg (|t| * |X ω|)
  have h_f_bounded : ∃ M, f ≤ᵐ[μ] fun ω => M :=
    by refine ⟨Real.exp (|t| * Real.abs (Real.abs X)), fun ω => Real.exp_le_exp (|t| * |X ω|) (|t| * Real.abs (Real.abs X))⟩
  apply MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_eq_integral_Ioc_meas_le
  exact ht_int_pos
  exact h_f_nonneg
  exact h_f_bounded
